title: Deccan Pharma: VG-50 LTE link drops overnight
description: Deccan Pharma Packaging reports that 6 VG-50 Rev A gateways lose their LTE link between 1 and 3 AM and only recover after a power cycle. They are evaluating whether to accept the 60 units on SO-884.

comments.author: Sanjay Pillai
comments.body: Logs show the LM-4G module dropping its PDP context after the carrier's nightly maintenance window. The modem does not re-attach on its own.

comments.author: Rahul Iyer
comments.body: We can add a link watchdog in firmware that re-attaches the LM-4G after 3 failed pings. Can ship in Firmware 2.4 if it is prioritised.
